** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Mark the copy seen after a Finder or drag action.** When a user reveals or drags a ready copy, these handlers leave its unseen entry intact. The Library still shows the “copy ready” chip and outline after the user acts on the file. Mark the copy seen in both handlers, as the export toast does. If the ready card must remain visible after either action, separate card visibility from unseen state. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-coderabbit-v2/e45c845143ba72f35fea4fac2f9d62a186dff986/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts)) Also applies to: 93-93

Review comment at @apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/ready-copy-card.tsx at line 80: Update the reveal and drag handlers in the ready-copy card to mark the copy seen after the user acts, reusing the existing mark-seen flow used by the export toast. If either action must leave the card visible, keep card visibility independent from its unseen state. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```

**Do not expose the drag surface as an inert button.** The adjacent “Show in Finder” button provides the documented keyboard alternative. Change the drag surface to a non-interactive draggable element so Enter and Space do not target a control with no action.

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Expose progress while the pill is minimized.** The button’s `aria-label` announces only “Show the export's progress.” The `role="progressbar"` span is inside the button, whose descendants are presentational to assistive technology. A screen-reader user must expand the widget to learn the destination or percentage. Include the destination and percentage in the button’s accessible name, or place the progressbar outside the button. ([w3.org](https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/act/rules/307n5z/?utm_source=openai)) Based on learnings: check dynamic content regions for the ARIA information needed for screen-reader accessibility.
